description:
A complete candidate draft is verified and published once as durable immutable prerelease escrow before rehearsal.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The protected escrow workflow authenticates the candidate root, creates or safely resumes only its matching draft, uploads every exact candidate/evidence/recovery asset, and verifies numeric asset IDs, digests, attestations, tag, and source identities.
- [hard] REQ-02: Draft creation, each upload set, and publication use schema-valid prepared/completed records; mismatch never deletes, replaces, or edits an existing asset, and the published candidate prerelease is immutable.
- [hard] REQ-03: Endpoint and crash fixtures prove retry safety, least privilege, exact-root selection, and durable recovery without using Actions artifacts as the sole byte store.

## Notes

Blast radius: candidate-escrow workflow YAML, exact asset verification, and escrow fixtures only.
title: Implement immutable candidate escrow workflows
